scripts.start: npm run build:host && npm run bundle && tsc && npm run bundle:preload && npm run sync-napi && electron .
scripts.sync-napi: test -f ../../target/release/libstarriver_desktop.dylib && cp ../../target/release/libstarriver_desktop.dylib ../../target/release/starriver_desktop.node && (uname -s 2>/dev/null | grep -qi darwin && codesign --force --sign - ../../target/release/starriver_desktop.node && echo 'NAPI: signed .node' || echo 'NAPI: no macOS codesign (skipped)') && echo 'NAPI: synced dylib -> .node' || echo 'NAPI: skipping (dylib not found, run cargo build first)'
scripts.build: npm run build:host && npm run bundle && tsc && npm run bundle:preload
scripts.test:e2e: cargo build --release -p starriver-desktop && npm run sync-napi && npm run bundle && playwright test -c e2e/playwright.config.ts
